description.en: The DC power jack class for a 5.5 × 2.1 mm barrel plug: a Ø2.0 mm centre pin in a bore that takes a Ø5.5 mm plug 9.5 mm deep. Many consoles' and handhelds' power inlets use it.
description.es: La clase de jack de alimentación DC para un plug de barril de 5.5 × 2.1 mm: un pin central de Ø2.0 mm en un barreno que recibe un plug de Ø5.5 mm a 9.5 mm de profundidad. Las entradas de alimentación de muchas consolas y portátiles lo usan.
description.fr: La classe de jack d'alimentation CC pour une fiche cylindrique 5,5 × 2,1 mm : une broche centrale de Ø2,0 mm dans un alésage qui reçoit une fiche de Ø5,5 mm sur 9,5 mm de profondeur. Les entrées d'alimentation de nombreuses consoles et portables l'utilisent.
description.pt: A classe de jack de alimentação CC para um plugue de barril de 5,5 × 2,1 mm: um pino central de Ø2,0 mm num furo que recebe um plugue de Ø5,5 mm a 9,5 mm de profundidade. As entradas de alimentação de muitas consolas e portáteis usam-no.

governing.designation: DC power jack for a 5.5 × 2.1 mm barrel plug (COTS class)

sources.title: Same Sky PJ-002A DC power jack (rev 1.10) datasheet
sources.supports: centre pin Ø2.0; mating plug Ø5.5; bore Ø6.50; jack insertion depth 9.5

sources.title: Same Sky PJ-102A DC power jack (rev 1.07) datasheet
sources.supports: centre pin Ø2.0; mating plug Ø5.5; bore Ø6.40; jack insertion depth 9.5

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the bore on the jack's front face. +z points out of the bore, toward a plug; the body lies at z < 0. +x is an arbitrary radial reference: the bore is round, so the interface has continuous symmetry.

plug_diameter.note: the mating plug the sheet names; PJ-102A the same (source 1)

bore_diameter.note: PJ-102A draws Ø6.40 (source 1): it varies by part

interfaces.note: Female: a 5.5 × 2.1 plug enters the bore over the centre pin, 9.5 deep, so a mate seats the plug's collar on this face.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (console-hyperobjects standard-parts lane, 2026-11-01); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: No source names IEC 60130-10 or an EIAJ designation, so this is a class entry stated by the facts two PCB jacks of one maker share. A panel-mount member (a threaded bushing) varies by part and is not stated; the 2.1 mm plug bore is the plug's fact.
